title: VIP perk rebalance
items: VIP tab reordered with retuned comp costs — Slide Rule Lv1 is 1 comp (Lv2 scales ×10); several late perks are cheaper.
Shorter perk blurbs; I Cast Fireball no longer makes King Me merges explode.

title: Slide Rule early VIP
items: Slide Rule is now the first VIP perk (1 comp for Lv1, 10 comps for Lv2 log scale).
The ★ recommends Slide Rule before Quest Desk.

title: HUD tile layout polish
items: Top HUD tiles share equal width so chip counts no longer resize the row.
Level, Comps, and Auto tiles use bottom progress bars; Comps shows Cash Out on a second justified row.
Level label and XP fraction are centered; Auto keeps Multi Deal +X% while paused.

title: Control Booth tidy-up
items: Remove unnecessary toggles from the dock.
Chips Fly toggle added to the Control Booth column.
Slide Rule Lv2+: Rate toggle in booth and VIP switches Linear / Log (meter stays on at Lv1).

title: Quick Claim VIP perk
items: The ability to hold down on achievements to quickly claim multiple is now a perk, which should improve discoverability.
Tweaked the logic of some upgrade recommendations (★)

title: Plinker
items: Poker is now Plinker — a portmanteau of Plinko + Poker. Welcome screen, tab title, and settings copy updated.

title: Shorter number labels
items: Chip counts, costs, payouts, and mult abbreviations now cap at three digits (e.g. 1.23M, 999k).

title: Tab scroll position restored
items: Each rail tab (Upgrades, Quests, Achievements, VIP, Settings) keeps its own scroll position when you switch away and back.

title: Achievements & shop unlocks
items: Achievements shows a Claim button when ready rewards are offscreen — tap to jump back to the top.
Hold a claimable achievement to rip through ready rewards in series.
Locked shop upgrades and quest slots show a lock icon with unlock level.
Shop unlock levels retuned and listed in unlock order (Sweep Stakes Lv2 … Multi Deal Lv9).

title: Hot Streak retired
items: Hot Streak and House Edge are gone — chain multipliers still ramp from consecutive clears alone.
Saves that owned either get chips and comps refunded for what they spent.

title: HUD land bounce off
items: Chip and comps tile land pulses are disabled while we track down mobile shop scroll hitching.

title: Slide Rule
items: New VIP perk: Slide Rule — Lv1 unlocks the chips/s meter under Chips; Lv2 switches it to a log scale. Toggleable.

title: Fuse dock labels
items: Control Booth Fuse now reads Short / Normal instead of On / Off (shop card still uses On / Off).

title: Deal Me In
items: New VIP perk: Deal Me In — cards that settle while a hand is flashing can join that clear (upgrade it or add to the combo). Toggleable.

title: Star sits by the price
items: The recommended-buy ★ now appears after the upgrade or perk cost instead of before the name.

title: Shop list order stays live
items: Removed per-tab scroll memory and the freeze-while-browsing list order that was hitching flings.
The New-upgrade ↓/↑ cue and red New highlight on unviewed unlocks stay.

title: Quest & achievement chips level you up
items: Chip rewards from quests and achievements now count toward run level, same as chips earned at the table.

title: New upgrade highlight
items: Newly unlocked shop upgrades get the same red New highlight as What’s New entries until you scroll them into view.

title: Snappier score pops
items: Hand, combo, chain, and King Me score labels clear sooner so the board doesn’t stay buried in text.
Big pots still linger a little longer than small ones — just not for several seconds.

title: Rail scroll stays smooth
items: Browsing a shop tab no longer reshuffles its list under you — order refreshes when you leave and come back.
Recommended ★ no longer resizes upgrade cards as chips tick in.

title: Score pops stack on top
items: New score labels now slam in above older ones instead of hiding under lingering pops.

title: Scroll keeps its momentum
items: Shop lists no longer reshuffle under your finger mid-fling — upgrades, quests, and achievements wait until scrolling settles.

title: Smoother tab scrolling
items: Rail tabs no longer hitch or snap mid-scroll — each panel scrolls on its own instead of sharing one scroller.

title: Suits toggle labels
items: Suit Purge’s Suits toggle now reads Shown or Hidden to match the picker state.

title: Shop tab load fix
items: Fixed a script error from overlapping shop-tab updates that stopped Poker from loading.

title: Recommended buy star
items: A gold star marks the next recommended shop upgrade or VIP perk you can still buy.
Shop path: early Auto Dealer → Wild Card → Pin Tip → High Cut → Suit Alliance.
VIP path: Quest Desk, then Quest Ink.

title: New upgrade scroll cue
items: When a newly unlocked upgrade is offscreen in the shop, a ↓/↑ New button jumps you to it.

title: Tabs remember scroll
items: Each rail tab (Upgrades, Quests, Achieves, VIP, Settings) keeps its own scroll position when you switch away and back.

title: Chips bar hugs edge
items: The chips/s peak bar now sits flush on the Chips tile bottom edge with no gap.

title: Chips/s peak bar
items: The Chips tile now has a bar showing your live chips/s as a fraction of your peak.

title: Suit Alliance keeps the colors
items: Suit Alliance keeps all four suits on the table — diamonds ally with hearts at Lv1, clubs with spades at Lv2.
Flushes and Suit Purge treat each allied pair as one family; purge buttons show both glyphs.
Flush connector lines use the family color (heart red / spade purple) so mixed allies still read clearly.
Suit Purge pops immediately — no flash wait before cards explode.

title: Bumper bounce fix
items: Cards no longer kick hard left every time they hit a full-width bumper across a packed board.
Cards trapped under a bumper pop back onto the playable side instead of oscillating underneath.
Bumper hits shove nearby cards so a bounce can punch through a pile instead of getting smothered.
Open channels between two bumpers stay passable — cards are no longer yanked back up out of the gap.

title: Comps Cash Out hint
items: The Comps HUD tile now shows how many comps Cash Out will collect, and lights up when you’re ready.

title: Drop aim stays on the felt
items: The drop indicator and next-card preview only show while your cursor is over the board.

title: Chips/s achievement
items: New achievement: Chip Flood — hit peak chips/s on the Chips HUD (infinite tiers).

title: I Cast Fireball
items: VIP fire perk renamed to I Cast Fireball — same blast ignite, clearer name.
New achievement: I Didn't Ask How Big The Room Was — light cards on fire.

title: Control Booth
items: New VIP perk: Control Booth — puts every owned On/Off toggle in a column beside the board.
Turn the Booth Off anytime to tuck the column away; VIP Lounge still has the full switch list.

title: Cashier’s Cage later
items: Cashier’s Cage now unlocks at run Lv 200 — a deep late-game chip sink, not a mid-run VIP shortcut.

title: Near-miss guides retired
items: Removed near-hand hint guides, the Settings toggle, and the Card Sense VIP perk (owners get 4 comps back).

title: Multi Deal mid-game
items: Multi Deal now unlocks at run Lv 8 (was Lv 4) and costs more up front — a mid-table spike for extra auto deals, not an early rush.

title: Hand resolve lines
items: Scoring hands flash bright connector dashes in the gaps between seats before clearing — easier to read combos without covering the cards.
Flush lines keep suit color; straights and rank hands use their own connector colors so mixed lines don’t look suited.

title: Crowned kings
items: Kings merge wherever they meet.
King Me kings wear a larger golden crown on the letter K.
Stacked kings count toward of-a-kind: a double king plus four kings in a line is six of a kind, and higher stacks keep climbing.
Improvements to score pops rendering and priority.

title: Auto Suit Purge unstuck
items: Fix Auto Purge.

title: Bigger chip readouts
items: Past Q (quadrillion), chip and mult readouts switch to scientific notation.

title: New uses for chips
items: New upgrade: Cashier’s Cage — spend chips to bank Cash Out comps (up to Lv 100).
Felt Grease goes to Lv 30 (late levels still speed the table, with softer gains). Big Blind to Lv 60 · Premium Cut to Lv 25.

title: Deeper Mitosis splits
items: Percussive Mitosis can bifurcate one generation further — chips shrink one more time on the pins before they stop splitting.

title: Mitosis leaves taps alone
items: Tap-to-deal works at full speed even with Mitosis active.

title: Steadier achievement cards
items: Fix flickering and unreliable clicks.

title: Siege column wipe fix
items: Siege Weapons no longer leaves permanent empty seats after a column slam.
Column wipes re-check the live stack at explode time so chips that seated during the flash get cleared too.

title: Fix jerky upgrade and perk cards
items: Blind, payout, combo, and Card Counting multipliers now show on the Level HUD tile instead of shop and VIP effect lines.

title: Count every card in play
items: Card Counting now tallies duplicates across the whole table — settled board cards and chips still falling through the pins.
Multi Deal caps at 150% extra-card chance (Lv 6).

title: King Me merges
items: King Me no longer hops from the bottom row — instead, two kings of the same suit that meet stack into a crowned king.
Matching stacks keep merging (double king, triple, …) with exponentially bigger chip payouts.

title: House Edge matches Hot Streak
items: House Edge now caps at Lv 10 — same as Hot Streak — so VIP no longer offers dozens of useless heater levels.

title: Connect 4
items: New VIP perk: Connect 4 — flushes only need 4 suited cards instead of 5.
Near-miss flush guides update automatically: three suited cards are one away once you own it.

title: Fireball improvements
items: Cards in the pins can also light on fire.
Remove flying fireball sparks — the blast itself lights nearby cards instantly.

title: Pot milestones grow faster
items: Big Pot and Combo Payday targets now jump ~10× per tier after the early milestones — fewer levels for the same huge payouts.

title: Blast fires & burning hands
items: I Didn't Ask How Big the Room Was now lights nearby cards in the blast — fireballs are the spark traveling to those neighbors.
Poker hands that include burning cards pay +50% per lit card. Score pops go orange when fire pays.

title: Flaming crowned kings
items: With I Didn't Ask How Big the Room Was on, crowned kings leap aflame and light nearby cards as they jump.
Burning cards keep dripping chips during King Me leaps — they only ash out once the crown lands.

title: I Didn't Ask How Big the Room Was
items: New VIP perk: explosions cast fireballs that light other cards on fire.

title: Suit Purge fix
items: Buying Auto Purge collapses the suit picker again without stopping purges.
Shop Hide/Show and the bar tap only hide the picker — auto purges keep working when Auto Purge is on.
Older saves that accidentally paused Suit Purge are migrated back to armed.

title: King Me VIP perk
items: New VIP perk: King Me — kings that reach the bottom row get crowned with a second king on top.
Crowned kings leap diagonally over cards for big chips, then explode after a few jumps. Toggle On/Off anytime.

title: Pit Boss speed-up
items: Pit Boss auto-buys up to five affordable upgrades per tick again — no extra VIP levels required.

title: Upgrade balance pass
items: Hot Streak caps at Lv 10. VIP skill perks (Quick Deal, Pin Privilege, Felt Wax, House Edge) raise their paired table upgrade chip costs like normal levels.
Auto Dealer stays cheap through Lv 6, then shifts to a pricier curve for top speed. Multi Deal is back: +25% extra-card chance per level on each auto tick; above 100% can deal multiple.
Short Fuse is toggleable — pause fast clears when stacking combos or Card Counting pairs.
Suit Purge shop toggle arms/disarms the blast (bar tap minimizes suit buttons). Purges pay per card; auto-target avoids breaking duplicate pairs.
Siege Weapons: bumper smash clears a column (Lv 1), every column on that bumper (Lv 2), or slams the landing column for a combo payout (Lv 3). Bumper hits pay Rail Tax.
Storm the Beaches pays chips for every card that survives the peg gauntlet and enters the columns.

title: Deep Stack to Lv 200
items: Deep Stack achievement tiers now span the full run climb through level 200.

title: Big pots & trophy case
items: New Big Pot achievement tracks your highest single-hand chip payout.
New Combo Payday achievement tracks your biggest COMBO resolve (all hands combined).
New Trophy Case achievement rewards claiming achievement tiers.
Double Down no longer duplicates the first COMBO milestone — C-Combo owns ×2.

title: Card Counting tiers
items: Card Counting is back to eight +8% duplicate levels, with a ninth tier that multiplies level payout by paired-card products.
Table Tilt moved to the bottom of the VIP lounge.

title: Quest sparkle colors
items: Quest claim sparkles and glows now match the quest rarity color.
Auto-claim tab bursts tint particles from the claimed quest tier.

title: Quest Ink odds
items: Quest Ink now shifts rolled quest odds toward higher rarities — max level makes Rare the most common roll.
Common quest cards use a white accent instead of the default green label.

title: VIP and achievement polish
items: Achievement and VIP perk names updated.
Siege Weapons can be toggled On/Off in the VIP lounge.
Card Counting now multiplies your level payout mult by the product of paired cards on the board.

title: Storm the Beaches blast
items: Pin-shell explosions blast nearby chips outward — bigger radius, stronger shove, fades with distance.

title: Siege Weapons VIP perk
items: New VIP perk: Siege Weapons — some cards grow spikes that smash bumpers and clear the top row.
Upgrade again so spiked cards can temporarily shatter pins on contact.

title: Chips per second
items: The Chips HUD now shows a live chips/s rate from recent table earnings.

title: Highest combo achievements
items: New infinite Multiway achievement for your biggest COMBO — climb ×2, ×3, ×4… one step at a time.

title: Storm blasts knock chips
items: Storm the Beaches explosions now shove nearby falling chips outward — seating cards can get yanked back into the pegs.

title: Premium rim polish
items: Silver, Gold, and Diamond cards keep a metallic rim — the center stays suit felt.
Suit glyphs sit lower on the chip; grid windows open a bit so premium rims stay visible.

title: Storm the Beaches VIP perk
items: New expensive VIP perk: Storm the Beaches — Auto Dealer runs ~3× faster, but cards can randomly explode on pins.
Toggle On/Off anytime.

title: Pin Split VIP perk
items: New expensive VIP perk: Pin Split — drops come ~10× slower, but cards bifurcate on every pin.
Split chips shrink each bounce, then snap back to full size when they enter a column. Toggle On/Off anytime.

title: Heater survives refresh
items: Your Hot Streak chain is saved with the run — refreshing or updating no longer resets the heater.

title: Softer chain pops
items: CHAIN banners ease in gentler now — rapid-fire combos still stack, without the hard slam.

title: Chain pops rapid-fire on combos
items: Multi-hand clears slam CHAIN ×N banners in quick succession — one pop per heater step, not a single jump.

title: Bigger combos, hotter heaters
items: COMBO banners scale up with the number of hands you clear at once.
Multi-hand clears advance your chain once per hand — a COMBO ×3 jumps the heater three steps.

title: Instant vs Cash Out comps
items: Rewards that pay comps right away now say “instant comps” (same VIP currency, just immediate).
Banked level and quest credit still says “Cash Out comps” — collected when you Cash Out.

title: Chain banner stays honest
items: Suit Purge no longer flashes a low CHAIN ×N mid-heater — your streak carryover is preserved for the next hand without the fake dip.

title: More achievements
items: New achievements: sleeve Ace hands, VIP perks purchased, and opening Settings.
Secret achievement for updating Poker to a new version — hidden until you unlock it.

title: Celebration labels stay on the felt
items: Hand score popups near the left or right edge stay readable — they can hang a little past the felt instead of getting chopped off by the board frame.

title: Sleeve & counting
items: New VIP perk Ace Up Your Sleeve (100 comps) — each line scores the best hand from its cards plus a hidden Ace.
New VIP perk Card Counting — bigger hand payouts for duplicate cards on the table.

title: Update prompt
items: If a new Poker build ships while your tab is still open, a banner offers Refresh so you pick up the latest.

title: Next tile stay put
items: The Next HUD tile keeps a steady width when the upcoming card changes, so the header no longer jitters on desktop.

title: VIP tab badge
items: Cash Out no longer adds to the VIP tab count — only affordable VIP perks do.
When Cash Out is ready and nothing else is, the VIP tab shows a plain badge (no number).

title: Suit Purge collapse
items: Suit Purge collapses the first time you unlock Auto Purge.
Tap the Suit Purge bar outside the suit buttons to show or hide the picker.

title: Shop math & Auto Dealer
items: VIP skill bonuses now raise matching upgrade buy costs and surface Blind / payout / combo multipliers on shop rows.
Auto Dealer caps at Lv 12 with steeper costs.
The Auto HUD bar fills better at fast rates.

title: WIP: Table Tilt
items: New VIP perk Table Tilt steers peg falls from device motion (if supported).
Attempt portrait lock while tilt is active.

title: Short Fuse & Suit Purge UI
items: Short Fuse speeds hand-clear explosions separately from Felt Grease ball physics.
Suit Purge charge bar when minimized; suit color flashes when auto-casting.

title: Deep run levels
items: Run level climbs to 200.
Additional quest slots unlock later.
Late-game payout and combo multipliers; chip bonuses spread across the climb.
Level-up toast removed.

title: VIP perk rework
items: Felt Wax, Hot Streak, and Open Blind join the VIP lounge.
Card Sense and Auto Purge move from the table shop to VIP perks.
Gold perk segments lead upgrade progress bars; VIP bonus levels count toward skill caps.

title: Achievements & HUD polish
items: Achievements gain infinite tiered levels, sort by progress %, and pulse the numerator when it ticks up.
Fix: Higher hands count toward lower-category achievement stats; royal flush counts for straight flush goals.
Tabs buttons show a red dot on new unlocks; Auto HUD toggles Auto Dealer.

title: Wild Card & Premium Cut
items: Wild Card upgrade deals Uno-style any-suit chips.
Premium Cut adds tiered card hand multipliers with metallic premium glyphs.
Compact stacked HUD tiles on mobile to stop layout jumping.

title: Suit Purge & celebrations
items: Hide/Show toggle for the Suit Purge picker; lower cooldown at max level; purges pop in-flight cards.
Quest claim effects, reward particles, and auto-buy upgrade celebration.
Chips land on the tile edge with mobile tab particle bursts.

title: Tiered achievements
items: Achievements unlock multiple claimable tiers with save migration.
Pit Boss becomes a single-level VIP perk; Hold Deal removed from VIP.

title: Juice & settings
items: Chip pop-and-fly to the chip counter, with a setting to disable the animation.
Click the level pill to see unlocks so far and what’s next.
Felt-and-gold casino card textures; four-color suit glyphs.

title: Welcome, VIP & quests
items: Welcome tab for first-time Poker.
VIP Lounge unlocks with your first permanent comps.
Levels, prestige, and quests join the sidebar.
Auto floor clear when the board is full.

title: Plinko Poker idle
items: Plinko Poker launches.
Idle upgrades: spend chips on Auto Dealer, Big Blind, and table skills between hands.
